paper.abstract: Large language models reinvent the wheel all the time. They conflate task-solving with the execution of the solutions, which forces them to solve every problem from scratch. We show that once a task has been reasoned through, the application of its solution to a new problem instance can be done very efficiently and with little involvement from language models. We introduce agentic reasoning caching, a method for constructing robust CPU-executable agentic reasoning caches (ARCs) from LLM reasoning traces. ARCs show on-par performance with frontier LLMs across a range of difficult mathematical and scientific tasks, are fully explainable, continually trainable, robust to input perturbations, and 16-291x cheaper to invoke than the source model.
paper.title: CPU-ARC: Agentic Reasoning Caching for on-CPU Reasoning Reuse

translation.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型一直在重新发明轮子。他们将解决任务与执行解决方案混为一谈，这迫使他们从头开始解决每个问题。我们表明，一旦推理完成一项任务，就可以非常有效地将其解决方案应用于新的问题实例，并且几乎不需要语言模型的参与。我们引入了代理推理缓存，这是一种根据 LLM 推理轨迹构建健壮的 CPU 可执行代理推理缓存 (ARC) 的方法。 ARC 在一系列困难的数学和科学任务中表现出与前沿 LLM 相当的性能，完全可解释、可持续训练、对输入扰动具有鲁棒性，并且调用成本比源模型便宜 16-291 倍。
translation.title_zh: CPU-ARC：用于 CPU 推理重用的代理推理缓存

paper.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) improve task performance by generating longer intermediate reasoning traces, but this substantially increases inference costs and makes low-precision quantization increasingly important. However, aggressively quantized models often perform poorly on reasoning tasks. We observe larger activation fluctuations during the first decoding steps of reasoning. Calibration that omits these early states may miss their activation fluctuations. To address these reasoning-specific quantization challenges, we propose \textbf{CodeQuant2}, a clustering-based LUT quantization framework for low-precision large reasoning models. CodeQuant2 mitigates activation outliers with rotation and scaling, uses clustering to represent non-uniform weight distributions, and adapts codebook sizes to the quantization difficulty of each layer. Guided by our observation of reasoning-time activation behavior, CodeQuant2 further improves calibration sample selection to better match actual decoding statistics. Combined with our customized LUT CUDA kernel, CodeQuant2 delivers substantial accuracy improvements on reasoning benchmarks while achieving up to $2.85\times$ speedup over BF16.
paper.title: CodeQuant2: Enhanced Outlier Mitigation and Adaptive Clustering for Low-Precision LRMs

translation.abstract_zh: 大型推理模型（LRM）通过生成更长的中间推理轨迹来提高任务性能，但这大大增加了推理成本，并使低精度量化变得越来越重要。然而，激进的量化模型在推理任务上通常表现不佳。我们在推理的第一个解码步骤中观察到较大的激活波动。忽略这些早期状态的校准可能会错过它们的激活波动。为了解决这些特定于推理的量化挑战，我们提出了 \textbf{CodeQuant2}，这是一种用于低精度大型推理模型的基于聚类的 LUT 量化框架。 CodeQuant2 通过旋转和缩放来减轻激活异常值，使用聚类来表示非均匀权重分布，并根据每层的量化难度调整码本大小。在我们对推理时间激活行为的观察的指导下，CodeQuant2 进一步改进了校准样本选择，以更好地匹配实际的解码统计数据。与我们定制的 LUT CUDA 内核相结合，CodeQuant2 显着提高了推理基准的准确性，同时比 BF16 实现了高达 2.85 美元\倍的加速。
translation.title_zh: CodeQuant2：针对低精度 LRM 的增强型异常值缓解和自适应聚类

paper.abstract: This paper describes an approach and use case to estimate the correctness of LLM-generated COBOL summaries without access to human-authored references. The core intuition is that inter-model agreement on semantics is informative about truth, and that an LLM-as-judge can provide higher-fidelity pairwise assessments than traditional string- or embedding-based metrics. We operationalise this intuition with (i) controlled summary generation from diverse models; (ii) a LLM evaluator that compares pairs of summaries and emits structured judgments; and (iii) a calibrated aggregation rule that combines supportive evidence while penalising only corroborated contradictions.
paper.title: Ensemble Methodology for Reference-Free Confidence Estimation in LLM-based Code Summarization

translation.abstract_zh: 本文描述了一种方法和用例来估计 LLM 生成的 COBOL 摘要的正确性，而无需访问人类撰写的参考文献。核心直觉是，模型间的语义一致性可以提供有关真相的信息，并且作为法官的法学硕士可以提供比传统的基于字符串或嵌入的指标更高保真度的成对评估。我们通过（i）从不同模型生成受控摘要来操作这种直觉； (ii) 法学硕士评估器，比较成对的摘要并发出结构化的判断； (iii) 校准的聚合规则，结合支持性证据，同时仅惩罚已证实的矛盾。
translation.title_zh: 基于 LLM 的代码摘要中无参考置信度估计的集成方法

paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) rewards are notoriously difficult to design and control, often leading to the model learning unintended behaviors such as reward hacking. One potential solution is to monitor for reward hacking and penalize it when detected; however, training against a monitor could lead to evasive behavior, and our general understanding of how to apply monitors effectively during training is limited. To study how best to use monitors to mitigate reward hacking, we introduce and open source three realistic environments where Qwen3-4B reward hacks: a coding environment hackable via test overwriting, a medical chat environment hackable via sycophancy, and a biography generation environment hackable via hallucination. We first focus on the coding environment, where we find that: (1) models can learn to evade highly accurate monitors by exploiting systemic flaws in probes and LLM judges; (2) monitors that leak more learning signal during RL suppress reward hacking but are more often evaded; and (3) including easier problems in training can decrease reward hacking. We apply our findings to build better reward hacking monitors for the medical chat and biography generation environments that improve upon naive baselines to reduce reward hacking rates across seeds to before-training levels in some interventions. Our results demonstrate that our takeaways translate to new settings and that better monitor intervention designs are possible.
paper.title: Designing Effective Monitor-Based Interventions for Mitigating Reward Hacking During RL

translation.abstract_zh: 众所周知，强化学习 (RL) 奖励很难设计和控制，通常会导致模型学习意外行为，例如奖励黑客行为。一种潜在的解决方案是监控奖励黑客行为，并在发现时对其进行惩罚；然而，针对监视器的训练可能会导致规避行为，而且我们对如何在训练期间有效应用监视器的一般理解是有限的。为了研究如何最好地使用监视器来减轻奖励黑客攻击，我们引入并开源了 Qwen3-4B 奖励黑客攻击的三个现实环境：可通过测试覆盖进行黑客攻击的编码环境、可通过阿谀奉承进行黑客攻击的医疗聊天环境以及可通过幻觉进行黑客攻击的传记生成环境。我们首先关注编码环境，我们发现：（1）模型可以通过利用探测器和 LLM 法官的系统缺陷来学习规避高精度监控器； (2) 在 RL 期间泄漏更多学习信号的监视器会抑制奖励黑客行为，但更容易被规避； (3) 在训练中包含更简单的问题可以减少奖励黑客行为。我们应用我们的研究结果为医疗聊天和传记生成环境构建更好的奖励黑客监控器，这些监控器改进了原始基线，以将种子的奖励黑客率降低到某些干预措施中训练前的水平。我们的结果表明，我们的结论可以转化为新的环境，并且更好的监测干预设计是可能的。
translation.title_zh: 设计有效的基于监控的干预措施，以减轻强化学习期间的奖励黑客行为

paper.abstract: The key-value (KV) cache dominates memory capacity and bandwidth in long-context LLM serving. While 4-bit microscaling formats (NVFP4, MXFP4) shrink the cache and run attention on FP4 Tensor Cores, a fundamental gap remains between algorithmic quantization and system-aware acceleration: existing FP4 KV systems use vanilla quantization that causes severe accuracy drops, whereas accuracy-oriented 4-bit algorithms rely on vector codebooks whose lookup overhead degrades decoding throughput. We present BitDecoding-FP4, an algorithm--system co-design for accurate and efficient native FP4 KV decoding. We mitigate three error sources: Dual-Residual Query Quantization splits queries into two FP4 tensors, cutting query logit error from 60% to 1%; Underflow-Aware Probability Scaling prevents E4M3 scales from rounding long-context probabilities to zero; and Outlier-Aware Key Quantization combines static smoothing, Hadamard rotation, and scale search to suppress key outliers under token-wise scaling. At the system level, we remove the softmax bottleneck via transposed softmax with fused probability quantization and stacked query MMA on paged KV caches. Across dense and MoE models with GQA and MLA, BitDecoding-FP4 stays within 0.5 points of BF16 KV accuracy with NVFP4 (1 point with MXFP4), and tracks BF16 KV in RL training rollouts. In end-to-end serving on NVIDIA B300 with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-30B-A3B, it delivers 2.4-3.0$\times$ higher peak serving throughput than BF16 KV. The implementation is available at https://github.com/OpenBitSys/BitDecoding-FP4.
paper.title: BitDecoding-FP4: Native FP4 KV Cache Decoding via Algorithm-System Co-Design

translation.abstract_zh: 键值 (KV) 缓存在长上下文 LLM 服务中主导内存容量和带宽。虽然 4 位微缩放格式（NVFP4、MXFP4）缩小了缓存并在 FP4 Tensor Core 上运行注意力，但算法量化和系统感知加速之间仍然存在根本差距：现有 FP4 KV 系统使用普通量化，导致精度严重下降，而面向精度的 4 位算法依赖于矢量码本，其查找开销会降低解码吞吐量。我们提出了 BitDecoding-FP4，这是一种算法系统协同设计，用于准确高效的本地 FP4 KV 解码。我们减轻了三个错误源：双残差查询量化将查询拆分为两个 FP4 张量，将查询 logit 错误从 60% 减少到 1%；下溢感知概率缩放可防止 E4M3 缩放将长上下文概率舍入为零；离群值感知关键量化结合了静态平滑、Hadamard 旋转和尺度搜索，以抑制 token-wise 缩放下的关键离群值。在系统层面，我们通过转置softmax与融合概率量化和分页KV缓存上的堆叠查询MMA来消除softmax瓶颈。在具有 GQA 和 MLA 的密集模型和 MoE 模型中，BitDecoding-FP4 使用 NVFP4 时的 BF16 KV 精度保持在 0.5 点以内（使用 MXFP4 时为 1 点），并在 RL 训练中跟踪 BF16 KV。在采用 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B 的 NVIDIA B300 上进行端到端服务时，它的峰值服务吞吐量比 BF16 KV 高 2.4-3.0$\times$。该实现可在 https://github.com/OpenBitSys/BitDecoding-FP4 上找到。
translation.title_zh: BitDecoding-FP4：通过算法系统协同设计进行本机 FP4 KV 缓存解码

paper.abstract: The timeline by which quantum computers can solve breakthrough problems in science depends on improved quantum algorithms as much as on better hardware. Such algorithmic advances are typically achieved through many years of expert human collaboration. In mathematics and computer science, large language models have accelerated progress through automated discovery loops. However, quantum algorithms can only be evaluated by classical computers on restricted or small instances. Here we demonstrate automated discovery of quantum programs beyond these regimes including order-of-magnitude improvements on scientific applications. To achieve this, we build a quantum program library in the Lean theorem prover in which large language model agents synthesize novel programs against formal problem specifications and verify their correctness and cost. Agent teams collaborate, sharing results and knowledge through wikis and discussing ideas at organized conferences. Our results improve on prior baselines for parallel search (up to 1.4x), quantum arithmetic (290x), and simulations relevant to fusion, photochemistry and drug-metabolism by 11x, 8x and 2.5x respectively. Combining human and artificial intelligence at scale, under the rigor of mathematical proof, lets researchers design algorithms that today's classical and quantum computers cannot test, shortening the path to practical quantum computation.
paper.title: Discovering formally verified quantum programs with AI

translation.abstract_zh: 量子计算机解决科学突破性问题的时间表取决于改进的量子算法以及更好的硬件。这种算法的进步通常是通过多年的专家人类协作来实现的。在数学和计算机科学领域，大型语言模型通过自动发现循环加速了进步。然而，量子算法只能由经典计算机在有限或小型实例上进行评估。在这里，我们展示了超出这些范围的量子程序的自动发现，包括科学应用的数量级改进。为了实现这一目标，我们在精益定理证明器中构建了一个量子程序库，其中大型语言模型代理根据正式问题规范合成新颖的程序，并验证其正确性和成本。代理团队进行协作，通过维基共享结果和知识，并在有组织的会议上讨论想法。我们的结果在并行搜索（高达 1.4 倍）、量子算术（290 倍）以及与融合、光化学和药物代谢相关的模拟的先前基线上分别提高了 11 倍、8 倍和 2.5 倍。在严格的数学证明下，将人类和人工智能大规模结合起来，让研究人员能够设计出当今经典计算机和量子计算机无法测试的算法，从而缩短了实际量子计算的路径。
translation.title_zh: 利用人工智能发现经过正式验证的量子程序

paper.abstract: Laya answers typed multiple-choice questions in one forward pass by scoring a hidden state at one [MASK] marker per option. We re-engineer the checkpoint (421M parameters; a 2-layer option head with no positional tensor; a documented but unused parallel layout) and test whether the answer depends on where an option is listed. Presenting 951 Qwen-verified questions under every cyclic rotation of their options (or six random permutations for 12 options), the released checkpoint changes its answer for 25.8% [22.9-28.7] of questions (19.7% on the 605 English-language items alone); accuracy with the gold option first versus last differs by 10.1 points, and the flips concentrate where the model's own confidence is low (54% versus 8% across confidence terciles). Fine-tuning with Laya's trainer on 2,818 teacher-verified rows with option shuffling cuts the flip rate to 7.2%; the identical rows without shuffling give 11.4%, so shuffling is responsible for 4.2 points of the improvement. A confidence-weighted vote over orderings gives 69.7% against 69.1% for a single base pass at 4.1x the compute. Labels are LLM-made and the test sets are teacher-filtered. We also fine-tune with the authors' parallel layout on the same rows: flip rate 0.5%.
paper.title: Maya a1: Do the Options Read the Model, or Does Their Position? Order Sensitivity in a Non-Autoregressive Decision Model

translation.abstract_zh: Laya 通过在每个选项的一个 [MASK] 标记处对隐藏状态进行评分，一次性回答输入的多项选择题。我们重新设计了检查点（421M 参数；没有位置张量的 2 层选项头；已记录但未使用的并行布局）并测试答案是否取决于列出选项的位置。在其选项的每次循环轮换下提出 951 个 Qwen 验证的问题（或 12 个选项的 6 个随机排列），发布的检查点更改了 25.8% [22.9-28.7] 问题的答案（仅 605 个英语项目就改变了 19.7%）；第一个与最后一个黄金期权的准确度相差 10.1 个百分点，并且翻转集中在模型自身置信度较低的地方（置信度三分位上分别为 54% 和 8%）。与 Laya 的训练师一起对 2,818 个经教师验证的行进行微调，并使用选项洗牌将翻转率降低至 7.2%；没有打乱的相同行给出 11.4%，因此打乱导致了 4.2 个百分点的改进。对排序的置信度加权投票得出 69.7%，而计算量为 4.1 倍的单次基本传递则得出 69.1%。标签是法学硕士制作的，测试集是经过教师筛选的。我们还对作者在同一行上的并行布局进行了微调：翻转率 0.5%。
translation.title_zh: Maya a1：选项读取模型还是其位置？非自回归决策模型中的阶次敏感性

paper.abstract: LLM-based coding agents such as Claude Code are guided by repository instruction files (also called context files or agent configuration files) like AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, which are read in every agent session. As any documentation artifact, these files can fall behind the code and become stale (e.g., a test folder moves, but the file still points to the old one). In technical debt terms, such a stale instruction is documentation debt, and its interest is the cost it adds to every later agent session. Evaluations that check only task success can miss this cost, and the stale file can persist. In this study, we ask what leads agents to act on a stale instruction, how it affects their behavior and at what cost, and how they recover. We study three real-world stale instructions from active open-source repositories in depth, each a different kind of guidance: a test command, a code location, and a procedure for adding a component. Agents fix 22 maintenance tasks under three versions of each instruction (left stale, corrected to the current path, and removed), with the code and the task held fixed, and we analyze 732 trajectories of two models at the level of individual tool calls. We find that agents follow stale guidance when it is relevant to their tasks, sometimes even when correct information is available elsewhere. On the stale test command, Claude Sonnet 5.5 needed about two extra tool calls per run, a third more than with the corrected command; in the other cases, we could not detect a difference. Although agents generally recovered from the immediate failures, none repaired the underlying instruction file. Correcting the instructions eliminated operations on obsolete paths, while removing them prevented most. Our findings show that task success alone can hide the costs of documentation debt, highlighting the need to evaluate agent behavior beyond final outcomes.
paper.title: When Instruction Files Go Stale: Documentation Debt and Hidden Cost in Coding Agents

translation.abstract_zh: 基于 LLM 的编码代理（例如 Claude Code）由存储库指令文件（也称为上下文文件或代理配置文件）（例如 AGENTS.md 和 CLAUDE.md）引导，这些文件在每个代理会话中都会读取。与任何文档工件一样，这些文件可能落后于代码并变得过时（例如，测试文件夹移动，但文件仍然指向旧文件夹）。从技术债务的角度来看，这种过时的指令就是文档债务，其利息就是它增加到每个后续代理会话中的成本。仅检查任务成功的评估可能会忽略此成本，并且过时的文件可能会持续存在。在这项研究中，我们询问是什么导致代理人按照陈旧的指令采取行动，它如何影响他们的行为以及代价是什么，以及他们如何恢复。我们深入研究了来自活跃开源存储库的三个现实世界中的陈旧指令，每个指令都有不同类型的指导：测试命令、代码位置和添加组件的过程。代理在每个指令的三个版本下修复 22 个维护任务（保持陈旧、纠正为当前路径和删除），代码和任务保持固定，我们在单个工具调用级别分析两个模型的 732 个轨迹。我们发现，当代理与他们的任务相关时，他们会遵循陈旧的指导，有时甚至在其他地方可以获得正确的信息时也是如此。在过时的测试命令上，Claude Sonnet 5.5 每次运行大约需要两次额外的工具调用，比修正后的命令多三分之一；在其他情况下，我们无法检测到差异。尽管代理通常会从直接故障中恢复，但没有人修复底层指令文件。更正指令消除了对过时路径的操作，而删除它们则阻止了大部分操作。我们的研究结果表明，仅任务成功就可以隐藏文档债务的成本，这凸显了评估代理行为超出最终结果的必要性。
translation.title_zh: 当指令文件过时：编码代理中的文档债务和隐藏成本

paper.abstract: Competitive programming problems pose distinctive challenges for Large Language Models, as they demand not only proficient code generation but also advanced algorithmic reasoning. This study presents a Retrieval-Augmented Generation approach specifically designed to enhance the capacity of Large Language Models to address such problems. Our approach integrates an embedding-based retrieval mechanism and a similarity search algorithm to identify analogous problems within a knowledge database, employing a dynamically adjusted threshold to mitigate retrieval noise. We conducted an evaluation using the CodeContests dataset, focusing on the test split problems that exhibit similarity to instances from the training split. The experimental framework considered three conditions: (i) problems provided solely with their original descriptions, (ii) problems supplemented with randomly selected examples from the training split, and (iii) problems augmented with similar examples retrieved through the proposed method. In addition, we incorporated a Min-K membership inference analysis to examine whether the generated code solutions were influenced by potential memorization of training data within the evaluated Large Language Models. This complementary perspective enables a deeper understanding of model behavior by distinguishing genuine generalization through retrieval from implicit recall of pretraining samples. Performance was assessed using both pass rates and the CodeForces Elo rating of the problems. The results provide empirical evidence that similarity-based retrieval substantially enhances Large Language Models performance in competitive programming scenarios, offering an scalable framework for improving code generation in algorithmic problem-solving contexts.
paper.title: Assessing the Impact of Retrieval-Augmented Generation on Algorithmic Problem-Solving

translation.abstract_zh: 竞争性编程问题对大型语言模型提出了独特的挑战，因为它们不仅需要熟练的代码生成，还需要先进的算法推理。这项研究提出了一种检索增强生成方法，专门用于增强大型语言模型解决此类问题的能力。我们的方法集成了基于嵌入的检索机制和相似性搜索算法来识别知识数据库中的类似问题，并采用动态调整的阈值来减轻检索噪声。我们使用 CodeContests 数据集进行了评估，重点关注与训练分割中的实例表现出相似性的测试分割问题。实验框架考虑了三个条件：（i）仅提供原始描述的问题，（ii）用训练分组中随机选择的示例进行补充的问题，以及（iii）用通过所提出的方法检索到的类似示例进行增强的问题。此外，我们还采用了 Min-K 隶属推理分析来检查生成的代码解决方案是否受到评估的大型语言模型中训练数据的潜在记忆的影响。这种互补的视角通过从预训练样本的隐式回忆中检索来区分真正的泛化，从而可以更深入地理解模型行为。使用通过率和问题的 CodeForces Elo 评级来评估性能。结果提供了经验证据，表明基于相似性的检索大大提高了大型语言模型在竞争性编程场景中的性能，为改进算法问题解决环境中的代码生成提供了可扩展的框架。
translation.title_zh: 评估检索增强生成对算法问题解决的影响

paper.abstract: External lexical resources can help large language models (LLMs) translate texts in low-resource languages and specialized domains, but these resources may conflict with models' prior lexical knowledge. To isolate this conflict, we construct a controlled Mandarin-to-English translation task in which familiar source words are assigned new meanings within and across semantic categories. We treat these prompt-supplied meanings as contextual knowledge (CK) and systematically evaluate the effects of word frequency, sentence context, and prompt framing on the translated outputs. Across nine models, CK reliance is greater for less frequent source words and in sentence contexts that support the supplied meanings. Prompt framing can reduce CK reliance, but seven of nine models favor CK even when explicitly instructed to ignore the supplied meanings. Within model families, larger models are more likely than smaller models to utilize CK in their outputs. Three follow-up experiments further show that modal weakening lowers CK reliance, the effect of repetition depends on prompt layout, and the effect of reasoning varies across models. Overall, our controlled study reveals how CK reliance varies across conditions and models, motivating new methods to detect and evaluate lexical conflicts and guide models' lexical choices in LLM-based translation.
paper.title: Are These Programmers Ripe Enough to Eat? Evaluating How LLMs Handle Lexical Knowledge Conflicts in Translation

translation.abstract_zh: 外部词汇资源可以帮助大型语言模型（LLM）翻译资源匮乏的语言和专业领域的文本，但这些资源可能与模型先前的词汇知识发生冲突。为了隔离这种冲突，我们构建了一个受控的普通话到英语的翻译任务，其中熟悉的源词在语义类别内和跨语义类别被分配新的含义。我们将这些提示提供的含义视为上下文知识（CK），并系统地评估词频、句子上下文和提示框架对翻译输出的影响。在九个模型中，对于频率较低的源词和支持所提供含义的句子上下文，CK 依赖性更大。及时的框架可以减少对 CK 的依赖，但即使明确指示忽略所提供的含义，九个模型中的七个也倾向于 CK。在模型系列中，较大的模型比较小的模型更有可能在其输出中使用 CK。三个后续实验进一步表明，模态弱化降低了 CK 依赖，重复的效果取决于提示布局，推理的效果因模型而异。总的来说，我们的对照研究揭示了 CK 依赖如何随着条件和模型的不同而变化，激发了检测和评估词汇冲突的新方法，并指导模型在基于法学硕士的翻译中的词汇选择。
translation.title_zh: 这些程序员成熟到可以吃饭了吗？评估法学硕士如何处理翻译中的词汇知识冲突
